name: mystery
description: An unexplained fact the reader wants resolved, with enough clues to form a theory.

name: conflict
description: Two parties want incompatible things, and the stakes are plain.

name: reframing
description: Something familiar is seen from an angle that changes what it means.

name: alien rule
description: The world works by a rule unlike ours, and the story shows one consequence of it.

name: dilemma
description: Someone has to choose between two costs, and neither is obviously right.

name: grief
description: Something or someone is gone, and the shape of the absence matters.

name: comedy
description: A joke, a farce or an absurd escalation that ends on a punchline.

name: revelation
description: One fact, delivered late or sideways, recasts everything before it.

name: scheme
description: Someone is attempting something audacious, and we see how, or how it goes wrong.

name: transgression
description: Someone breaks a rule or crosses a line, and something follows from it.

name: wonder
description: A genuinely marvelous thing, made specific enough to believe.

name: dread
description: A specific threat is near and getting nearer.

name: tenderness
description: A bond between people shows through a small act or object.

name: turning point
description: A single moment on which this world's history pivoted.

name: puzzle
description: The reader is handed enough to work something out before being told.
